Description: This template registers the Atlas side of the AWS Cloud Provider Access trust handshake, this will be billed to your Atlas account.

ProviderName.Description: Cloud provider of the access role. Only AWS is supported.

Profile.Description: Secret Manager Profile that contains the Atlas Programmatic keys.

RoleId.Description: Id of the Cloud Provider Access role. Use it with MongoDB::Atlas::EncryptionAtRest.

AtlasAWSAccountArn.Description: Atlas principal that assumes the customer's IAM role. Use it in the IAM role trust policy.

AtlasAssumedRoleExternalId.Description: External ID that the IAM role trust policy must require.
